system.name: Spectre
system.summary: Ecosystem manifest for @phcdevworks/spectre-shell — thin, framework-agnostic bootstrap shell for Spectre apps.

foundation.title: Foundation
foundation.description: Base design-system packages and adapters that higher layers build on.

build.title: Build
build.description: Composition and application-facing packages built on top of the foundation layer.

@phcdevworks/spectre-shell.description: Thin, framework-agnostic bootstrap shell for Spectre apps.
notes: Bootstrap entry point for Spectre applications.
Composes spectre-shell-router and spectre-shell-signals for routing and reactive state.

@phcdevworks/spectre-tokens.description: Design-token source for the Spectre system.

@phcdevworks/spectre-ui.description: Layer 2 styling contract between spectre-tokens and downstream adapters.

@phcdevworks/spectre-shell-router.description: Minimal, framework-agnostic client-side router for Spectre-based applications.

@phcdevworks/spectre-shell-signals.description: Minimal, framework-agnostic reactive primitives package for Spectre applications.

notes: Build packages may compose foundation packages and collaborate within the build layer.

boundaryConstraints.rule: Must not import Spectre packages outside its declared allowedTargets.
boundaryConstraints.reason: spectre-shell is the application entry point; its dependency surface is fixed to routing, signals, tokens, and UI.

generationRules: Do not add Spectre packages outside the declared allowedTargets.
Run npm run check before staging any commit.
usageGuidance: Routing is provided by spectre-shell-router; reactive state by spectre-shell-signals.
Token and styling values come from spectre-tokens and spectre-ui.
safeDefaults: Do not add Spectre component or adapter packages directly — use them via spectre-base or spectre-ui-astro.
Do not modify the bootstrap wiring without updating spectre.manifest.json.
